review_description: Salesperson was on time every time and responded immediately to any queries I had regarding the quote provided. Exceeded my expectations when it came to the installation. Team were polite, efficient and install went very smoothly with all packaging removed and follow up process of inspection and access to app for monitoring of system executed promptly. Grid connection in process of completion. Highly recommend this local team.
Thanks to the info you provided I felt I was able to make an informed (reasonably??) decision.
